name: Cai 2024 ustekinumab pediatric IBD PBPK reduced FcRn/lymphatic ODE

scenarios.name: Exact main Tables 1-3 and SI Tables S1-S8 anchor
scenarios.description: Short exact replay of curated public model constants, regimens, virtual-population descriptors, ontogeny factors, dose recommendations, predicted/observed PK endpoints, and sensitivity coefficients. This proves extraction and API field integrity, not independent dynamic prediction.

scenarios.name: Adult 390 mg IV induction (exploratory calibrated)
scenarios.description: Exploratory reduced ODE induction probe. Effective Vc and linear clearance are algebraically calibrated from the same paper-predicted Cmax and terminal half-life shown as comparator points, so endpoint agreement is calibration-target replay rather than independent validation. This is not the native 15-organ PK-Sim model.

scenarios.name: Adult 390 mg IV plus 90 mg SC q8w
scenarios.description: Exploratory calibrated ODE induction plus repeated subcutaneous maintenance simulation. Effective Vc and clearance are calibrated from the induction Cmax and half-life targets; SC absorption, distribution, and FcRn terms are unvalidated effective assumptions. It cannot reproduce native PK-Sim organ/FcRn population ribbons without the project and virtual populations.
